name: Suspicious Powershell In Registry Run Keys
description: Detects potential PowerShell commands or code within registry run keys
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Legitimate admin or third party scripts. Baseline according to your environment
query: (registry.path:(*\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run* OR *\\Software\\WOW6432Node\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run* OR *\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\Explorer\\Run*)) AND (winlog.event_data.Details:(*powershell* OR *pwsh\ * OR *FromBase64String* OR *.DownloadFile\(* OR *.DownloadString\(* OR *\ \-w\ hidden\ * OR *\ \-w\ 1\ * OR *\-windowstyle\ hidden* OR *\-window\ hidden* OR *\ \-nop\ * OR *\ \-encodedcommand\ * OR *\-ExecutionPolicy\ Bypass* OR *Invoke\-Expression* OR *IEX\ \(* OR *Invoke\-Command* OR *ICM\ \-* OR *Invoke\-WebRequest* OR *IWR\ * OR *\ \-noni\ * OR *\ \-noninteractive\ *))
